name: N'Djamena
subtitle: N'Djamena, capital of Chad: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Musée National houses the cast of Toumaï (~7 million years old), one of the earliest hominids known to science.

items.text: The Musée National du Tchad is founded, preserving ancient Sao culture.
The Grande Mosquée Fayçal opens opposite the Grand Marché.
Fossil skull of Toumaï is discovered, later displayed in cast at the Musée National.

gaps: Final analytical tables from the 2026 digital census (RGPH-3) are pending official release.
First-hand local voices from artisans of the Grand Marché and Chari river fishermen are missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
